apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
# Fixed

- With a pairing file made on a computer, “Open the device link” no longer stops with “peer closed connection without sending TLS close_notify” before iOS 26.4 (#105, #107). SideInstaller now answers the iPhone’s heartbeat while the link is open, as SideStore and StikDebug do.
